{{Quote|Aarrba's Repair Dock, under new management. It's all I ever wanted&hellip; more than Gav or I thought we could have.|Jori Daragon|<ref name="TFotSE5" />}}
'''Aarrba's Repair Dock''', also known as '''Aarrba's Repair and Salvage''', '''Aarrba the Hutt's docking bay and spacecraft repair''', and '''Aarrba the Hutt's service dock''', was a business operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Owned by [[Aarrba]], it offered cheap and quick [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair and salvage services out of a building in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]]. During the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system's]] [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]], the dock effected repairs on the ''[[Shadow Runner]]'', the ship of the supply runners [[Hok Daragon|Hok]] and [[Timar Daragon]]. When the pair subsequently [[Battle of Kirrek (Unification Wars)|perished]], Aarrba released the ''[[Starbreaker 12]]'', the Daragon's other starship that he had held in the dock as collateral, to their children, [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]]. They used the ship to become [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], but bad luck later forced them into debt to Aarrba over repairs made to the spacecraft.

After the Daragons returned from yet another unsuccessful exploration trip, Aarrba refused to release the ''Starbreaker 12'', once again held at his dock, until the pair paid for the ship's repairs. Soon enough, however, desperation drove the young explorers to steal the vessel from the repair bay and make a blind hyperspace jump that deposited them in the distant [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Jori eventually returned alone to the Koros [[Star system/Legends|system]] but was soon followed by a [[Sith invasion fleet]], of which Gav had been appointed [[Commander/Legends|commander]].

Aarrba's Repair Dock was damaged during the subsequent [[Battle of Koros Major (Great Hyperspace War)|attack]] on Koros Major as part of the Sith Empire's [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Jori rushed to the repair bay in order to obtain a starship that she could [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in battle, while Gav, accompanied by [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], also visited the dock to find his [[Gender/Legends|sister]]. When he met Aarrba, however, the dock owner fiercely denounced Gav, leading one of the Massassi to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. Arriving at the dock shortly thereafter, the shocked Jori used a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Protosaber|lightsaber]] to cut down Gav's soldiers and then hijacked a [[Jori Daragon's armed courier|nearby ship]] to pursue her similarly shocked brother, who was fleeing the scene. Following the Republic victory over the Sith Empire, which also saw the [[Battle at Primus Goluud|death]] of Gav, [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] of the Koros system helped Jori reopen Aarrba's Repair Dock under the latter's management.

==Description==
{{Quote|Had to install a whole new security system just to cut down on the parts people steal.|Aarrba|<ref name="TGAotS1" />}}
Aarrba's Repair Dock,<ref name="NEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> also known as Aarrba's Repair and Salvage,<ref name="TGAotS1" /> Aarrba the Hutt's [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] and [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] repair,<ref name="TFotSE4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 4]]</ref> and Aarrba the Hutt's service dock, was a starship repair<ref name="TGAotS0" /> and salvage business<ref name="TGAotS1" /> that was based in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] on<ref name="CSWE Aarrba" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE KorosMajor">{{CSWECite|II|226|Koros Major}}</ref> [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]].<ref name="CSWE Aarrba" /> It made use of a dome-shaped brick building,<ref name="TGAotS0" /> situated near the city's [[Monument to lost navigators/Legends|Monument to Lost Navigators]],<ref name="TGAotS1" /> that had an open space at the front of its tall entrance.<ref name="TGAotS0" /> The area had enough space for docking at least one starship.<ref name="TGAotS1" /> The structure itself, which had exposed bricks in multiple places, had six chimneys, and a pile of boxes and other equipment was at one point stacked against its wall to the right of the door.<ref name="TGAotS0" />

[[File:AarrbasRepairDockStarbreaker12-TGAotS1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Starbreaker 12'' being repaired at Aarrba's Repair Dock]]
The dock's spacious interior had room for at least two starships, and cables that could be attached to the ships being repaired hung from its high ceiling,<ref name="TGAotS0" /> where a small population of [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]] resided.<ref name="TGAotS1" /> The repair bay featured an elevated platform accessible by a tall staircase and held several barrels on the ground floor.<ref name="TGAotS0" /> The dock employed a group of organic workers and also made use of multiple [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including a pair of tread-equipped units and one [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] and several multi-legged ones<ref name="TGAotS1" />&mdash;and later a wheeled one, as well<ref name="TFotSE5" />&mdash;to effect ship repairs.<ref name="TGAotS1" /> By [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the owner of the facility, [[Aarrba]], had it outfitted with a new security system that involved the dock's droids monitoring any intruders via their [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].<ref name="TGAotS1" /> When the ownership of the business later passed to [[Jori Daragon]], she had a sign depicting a smiling Aarrba hung above the dock's entrance.<ref name="TFotSE5" />

Aarrba's business offered affordable, expedient, and discreet repairs to the clients' [[Realspace/Legends|spacegoing]] vessels and guaranteed all repair work, if only for a limited [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="TGAotS0" /> The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] also frequently lowered prices and extended credit for trusted clients<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|aarrba|Aarrba the Hutt}}</ref> but was wary of others, including<ref name="TGAotS0" /> his<ref name="DB" /> own employees, learning of such practices on his part.<ref name="TGAotS0" />

==History==
===Servicing supply runners===
{{Quote|Haw! I'm keeping the ''Starbreaker 12'' here as collateral until you come back.|Aarrba, to Hok and Timar Daragon|<ref name="TGAotS0" />}}
Aarrba's Repair Dock was in business during the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars]] of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]]<ref name="TGAotS0" /> in 5000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Toward the end of that conflict, Aarrba rendered repair services to the ''[[Shadow Runner]]'', the starship of the supply runners [[Hok Daragon|Hok]] and [[Timar Daragon]]. The work was done quickly, and the Hutt extended credit for the Daragons. Aarrba agreed to accept his payment in the form of a percentage of their profits as well as keeping the ''[[Starbreaker 12]]'', the Daragons' other ship that was also kept in the dock, as collateral until the pair would return from their supply run mission to the nearby planet [[Kirrek]].<ref name="TGAotS0" />

[[File:AarrbasRepairDockInterior-TGAotS0.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The ''Shadow Runner'' at Aarrba's Repair Dock shortly before departure for Kirrek.]]
On the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] the Daragons departed on their mission, a droid was effecting the last preparatory work on the ''Shadow Runner'' while others were loading supplies aboard the vessel. Before leaving the dock aboard their ship, Hok and Timar expressed their gratitude to Aarrba for his willingness to cooperate, while their children, [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and Jori, spent the time atop the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ''Starbreaker 12'', vocalizing their wish for their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] to take them along for the mission. At the same time, another vessel was parked outside the entrance to Aarrba's dock. The vehicle had a broken sail, and smoke was billowing out of its interior, with two droids attending outside the vessel.<ref name="TGAotS0" />

During their mission, the elder Daragons [[Battle of Kirrek (Unification Wars)|perished]], and when Aarrba was notified of the fact, he informed the supply runners' children while Gav was nearing the completion of repairs on the ''Starbreaker 12''. The owner of the dock, reasoning that Hok and Timar had paid for the collateral vessel in their [[Blood/Legends|blood]], gave it to Gav and Jori, who subsequently decided to use the ship to become<ref name="TGAotS0" /> [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]]. Luck in the young Daragons' chosen profession proved elusive, however, with the pair accumulating a large debt with Aarrba for repairs made on their ship.<ref name="TGAotS1" />

===Theft of the ''Starbreaker 12''===
{{Quote|You forgot about those new defensive systems, Gav. Aarrba warned us!''"<br />"''Don't worry, he won't have them programmed to destroy one of his ships&hellip; I hope!|Jori and Gav Daragon|<ref name="TGAotS1" />}}
Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> upon returning to Koros Major from a exploratory trip through the [[Starswarm Cluster/Legends|Starswarm Cluster]] that had once again left the ''Starbreaker 12'' in need of repairs, the Daragons contacted [[Cinnagar Control]] and asked to be relayed to Aarrba at his repair dock while the pair was bringing their ship in for a landing there. Over the [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]], the explorers begged the Hutt to help them out again. As the ''Starbreaker 12'' was subsequently undergoing repairs at Aarrba's dock, the Daragons attempted to convince the facility's owner to extend credit for them, but, since they did not have any collateral to offer, Aarrba refused and, no longer trusting the pair's promises, decreed that he would not return the ship to the explorers until they had repaid the repairs in full. In the process Aarrba also disclosed that his business was facing financial losses and that he had had to install a new security system in the dock merely in order to prevent people from [[Thief/Legends|stealing]] parts from the facility.<ref name="TGAotS1" />

[[File:Starbreaker12Theft-TGAotS1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The theft of the ''Starbreaker 12'' from Aarrba's Repair Dock]]
Refusing to give up, not long thereafter Gav visited Aarrba at the dock again, inquiring about the repairs on the ''Starbreaker 12''.<ref name="TGAotS1" /> He<ref name="TFotSE4" /> also tried to improve his and his [[Gender/Legends|sister's]] credit reliability by informing the Hutt that an affluent [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], [[Ssk Kahorr]], was already using a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace]] route the Daragons had [[Star map/Legends|charted]] and that they would therefore receive a substantial bonus soon. During the visit, however, the young explorer, concerned about his ship, verbally lashed out at one of the repair bay's droids working on the vessel for dropping a part on the floor.<ref name="TGAotS1" />

The Daragons were later accosted by [[Unidentified assassin 1|two]] [[Unidentified assassin 2|assassins]] sent by Kahorr, who was dissatisfied with the risky route the explorers had [[Map/Legends|mapped]]. Rattled from the encounter, Gav led Jori to Aarrba's dock and suggested that they steal the ''Starbreaker 12'' and go on a desperate, all-or-nothing exploration run to try and discover something valuable that could profit them. The pair stealthily entered the repair bay&mdash;albeit tripping the facility's security system in the process&mdash;and boarded their ship. Breaking it free of its tethers, Gav expressed his belief&mdash;although he was not sure of it&mdash;that Aarrba would not have [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] the dock's security system to destroy any of the Hutt's vessels, after which the ''Starbreaker 12'' left the dock. [[Koros starfighter|Cinnagar security starfighters]] attempted to intercept the illegal departure, but the Daragons made a random hyperspace jump<ref name="TGAotS1" /> that [[Daragon Trail|took]] them to the remote [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TGAotS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>

===The absence and return of the Daragons===
{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip;]'' they have repaid my kindness with treachery! Stolen their ship, damaged my repair dock!|Aarrba, on Gav and Jori Daragon|<ref name="TGAotS2" />}}
[[File:AarrbaTeta-TGAotS2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Aarrba complained to Empress Teta about damages to his repair dock.]]
During the Daragon siblings' absence from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space, Aarrba visited the Koros [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]]. The business owner told the empress about the pair's theft of the ''Starbreaker 12'', noting that his repair dock had been damaged in the process, and also asked that the fact that he had extended credit to them not be made publicly known.<ref name="TGAotS2" /> Meanwhile, after the Daragons had been [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] and sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]], Gav expressed to his sister his regret for stealing their ship from Aarrba.<ref name="TGAotS3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 3]]</ref>

Jori, having been separated from Gav in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]], eventually escaped [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] and returned to Koros Major, where she was promptly arrested and Kahorr took possession of the ''Starbreaker 12'' as recompense for the financial losses<ref name="TFotSE1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 1]]</ref> he<ref name="TGAotS2" /> had incurred while using the route charted by the Daragons.<ref name="TFotSE1" /> When the Sith Empire's [[Sith invasion fleet|fleet]] of [[Warship/Legends|warships]], having followed the route taken by Jori, subsequently [[Battle of Koros Major (Great Hyperspace War)|attacked]] Koros Major as part of its [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|invasion]] of the Republic, Jori&mdash;who had warned Empress Teta of the impending Sith threat&mdash;rushed to Aarrba's repair dock in order to find a suitable starship to pilot in combat against the invaders.<ref name="TFotSE3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 3]]</ref>

===Murder of Aarrba===
{{Quote|Whoa! That one almost hit Aarrba's Repair Dock!|Gav Daragon|<ref name="TFotSE3" />}}
[[File:JoriVsMassassi-TFotSE3.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Jori Daragon cutting down Massassi soldiers at Aarrba's Repair Dock]]
Meanwhile, Gav, whom the Sith Empire's [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], had made his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and appointed the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Sith [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], took a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] down to Cinnagar in order to find Jori. Narrowing his search by using a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] that reacted to the presence of a [[Jori Daragon's amulet|similar one]] worn by Jori, Gav arrived at Aarrba's dock, which had been damaged by bombardment during the battle. Landing his ship at the same time as the nearby Monument to Lost Navigators was destroyed&mdash;and immediately after the dock itself was nearly hit&mdash;Gav took the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under his [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] into the dock, where he hoped to find out Jori's location from Aarrba.<ref name="TFotSE3" />

However, upon seeing Gav, Aarrba immediately denounced him as a traitor<ref name="TFotSE3" /> and spat upon him.<ref name="DB" /> Believing the Hutt to be attacking his master,<ref name="CSWE Aarrba" /> one of the Massassi then killed the Hutt. In turn, before succumbing to his wounds, the owner of the dock crushed two of the Massassi to their deaths beneath his massive body. As Gav stood shocked at the scene of the massacre, Jori also arrived at the dock. Assuming that Gav had ordered for Aarrba to be killed, his similarly shocked sister ignited the [[Protosaber|lightsaber]] given to her by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] and cut down the Massassi present at the dock.<ref name="TFotSE3" /> As the grieving Jori knelt down by the side of Aarrba's body, the still-shocked Gav dropped his Sith amulet on the floor of the dock and ran away, taking off on his shuttle. Jori, unwilling to become separated from her brother again, then hijacked a [[Jori Daragon's armed courier|starship]] that had been parked nearby and pursued Gav to the Sith fleet.<ref name="TFotSE4" />

===Under new management===
{{Quote|I think even the old Hutt would be pleased!|Jori Daragon|<ref name="TFotSE5" />}}
[[File:JoriAarrbasRepairDock-TFotSE5.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Aarrba's Repair Dock under Jori Daragon's management]]
Later, after Gav had perished during a [[Battle at Primus Goluud|battle]] against Sadow's forces and the Republic had emerged victorious over the Sith Empire, Teta summoned Jori to her [[Empress Teta's palace|throne room]]. Considering the former explorer's losses during the conflict with the Sith, the empress inquired as to any way she could help Jori, to which she responded with her wish to reopen Aarrba's repair dock<ref name="TFotSE5" /> in the Hutt's memory.<ref name="CSWE Aarrba" />

Jori subsequently had the dock restored and opened to business again, and she herself took on an active role in carrying out repairs on the starships there. The new owner of the facility appreciated her situation, admitting that it was both all that she had ever desired and more than either she or Gav had ever hoped for&mdash;and she believed that the late Aarrba would have been pleased, as well.<ref name="TFotSE5" /> More than a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]] after Aarrba's death, his humble, charitable, and honest nature, coupled with his small business and tragic fate, had led other Hutts to disown him as an ancestor, instead holding up the later [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bogga]] as an example of success.<ref name="FF140">{{FactFile|140|HUT 15-18|The Hutts}}</ref> The Daragon siblings' theft of the ''Starbreaker 12'' from Aarrba's Repair Dock was eventually recorded in a [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history [[The Essential Chronology|chronicle]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TalesOfTheJedi-TheGoldenAgeOfTheSith0.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Aarrba's Repair Dock was introduced in ''Tales of the Jedi &ndash; The Golden Age of the Sith'' 0.]]
Aarrba's Repair Dock, referred to as "Aarrba the Hutt's service dock," first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 0|prologue issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series. The issue was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], penciled by [[Chris Gossett]],<ref name="TGAotS0" /> and published on [[July 31]], [[1996]].<ref name="TGAotS0 Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54589/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996)}}</ref>

Anderson's [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 1|subsequent issue]] of the series,<ref name="TGAotS1" /> published in [[October 9]] of the same year,<ref name="TGAotS1 Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54590/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_1|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #1}}</ref> further identified the facility as "Aarrba's Repair and Salvage,"<ref name="TGAotS1" /> and Anderson went on to introduce the name "Aarrba's Repair Dock" in the<ref name="TFotSE3" /> [[August 20]], [[1997]]<ref name="TFotSE3 Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54584/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_fall_of_the_sith_empire_1997_3|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Fall of the Sith Empire (1997) #3}}</ref> [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]'' series<ref name="TFotSE3" /> and "Aarrba the Hutt's docking bay and spacecraft repair" in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 4|fourth issue]]<ref name="TFotSE4" /> on [[September 17]] of the same year.<ref name="TFotSE4 Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54585/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_fall_of_the_sith_empire_1997_4|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Fall of the Sith Empire (1997) #4}}</ref> The [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] ultimately confirmed the capitalization of the name "Aarrba's Repair Dock."<ref name="NEGtC" />
